description: Call this when the person asks what they can upgrade or add to a device they own ("can I add more RAM to my laptop", "what SSD does my PC take", "what GPU fits my case") before suggesting parts: returns memory type, slots and maximum, M.2 slots, lengths and PCIe generation, power, CPU and cooler support for motherboards, GPU and cooler clearance for cases, the parts in our graph that fit (verified first) and the manufacturer's notes. Pass the exact model.

goal.description: Optional: what the person wants, e.g. 'more memory for video editing'.

model.description: The device's exact model number or name (laptop, motherboard, case, camera, tool...).
